title: This ChatGPT-powered stock picker helps you build a portfolio
excerpt: AI-powered analysis meets a portfolio builder built for everyday investors.
content_html:
TL;DR: Get lifetime access to Sterling Stock Picker for $49.97 (reg. $486) through Aug. 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

Credit: Sterling Stock Picker

$49.97
$486 Save $436.03

Researching stocks can quickly turn into a rabbit hole of financial statements, charts, and market jargon. Sterling Stock Picker is designed to condense that information into a more approachable way, using its North Star technology to analyze a stock’s financial, technical, and risk factors before giving it a buy, sell, hold, or avoid signal. It’s currently $49.97 for a lifetime subscription, price-dropped from $486, with the sale ending August 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

If you’ve used ChatGPT to make complicated information easier to understand, the Sterling Stock Picker takes a similar focus to stock research. Its Finley AI financial coach can answer questions about markets and portfolios in plain English, using real-time market data to explain what’s happening without requiring you to decode financial jargon on your own.

Mashable Deals

By signing up, you agree to receive recurring automated SMS marketing messages from Mashable Deals at the number provided. Msg and data rates may apply. Up to 2 messages/day. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help. Consent is not a condition of purchase. See our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

The stock picker does more than individual stock research, too. A five-minute risk-tolerance questionnaire helps personalize recommendations, while the Done-for-You Portfolio Builder can create a diversified portfolio based on your goals and risk profile. Stock Rockets surfaces companies with 50%+ quarterly revenue growth and high North Star ratings, while sector and industry insights provide a broader view of where market momentum is developing.

Mashable Trend Report

That combination could be useful for newer investors who want more guidance as they learn the ropes, as well as experienced investors who want to organize research more efficiently. Educational resources and strategy guides are included for those who want to understand the reasoning behind different investing concepts.

However, it’s worth noting that no AI tool can predict the market or eliminate investment risk. Sterling Stock Picker is better viewed as a research and educational tool that can help organize information and surface potential opportunities.

The lifetime subscription includes access through the web, iOS, and Android, along with future updates and no recurring monthly or annual costs.

Get the Sterling Stock Picker while it’s on sale for $49.97 (reg. $486) through Aug. 26 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

StackSocial prices subject to change.
